title: The Owner's drafts read in his own voice and copy into Gmail with a small Frequency logo above his name
description: On 10 Nov the Owner rewrote the Pages in Bloom draft by hand to sound like him and asked for every draft to match, and for a small Frequency logo above his name. His version ends the warm opening with an exclamation mark, introduces him as founder of Frequency with one easy question, signs off on three lines (Daniel Tyack, Founder, frequencylocal.com) and closes with a P.S.: he is local to San Diego (North County), where he found the address, and that he won't reach out again if they aren't interested. Today fwd signs off with one line "Founder, Frequency (frequencylocal.com)" and ends with "I found your address on ... Not interested? Reply \"no\" and I won't write again." Now composeBody writes his sign-off and that P.S. (still naming the source page and a reply-no opt-out, with the place from hunts.local_to), and the hunt brief carries his own opening as the example. Drafts stay plain text; the web Copy button also puts an HTML twin on the clipboard, with Frequency's round logo (a hosted image on frequencylocal.com, so it survives a paste into Gmail) right above the sign-off, and the draft view shows it there. Nothing is sent.
acceptance: A hunt draft ends with the Owner's three-line sign-off, then a P.S. saying he is local to San Diego (North County), naming the source page, with a reply-no opt-out
The hunt brief carries the Owner's own Pages in Bloom opening as its example
Copy puts text/plain and text/html on the clipboard; the HTML has a small hosted Frequency logo right above the Owner's name, live links and escaped text
A draft with no sign-off block gets no logo
